hints.title: Tree Degree Invariant and Slot Counting
hints.text: View serialization as filling available node capacity slots. Every non-null node consumes one slot and adds two new open slots.

hints.title: Null Node Slot Consumption
hints.text: A null indicator consumes one open slot but adds zero new slots. The count of open capacity slots must never drop below zero during traversal.

hints.title: Single Pass Slot Counter Check
hints.text: Start slots at 1. For each token separated by commas, decrement slots by 1. If slots is negative, return false. If token is not #, add 2 to slots. Return true if slots reaches exactly 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space validating tree degree balance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Explicitly reconstructing tree node structures incurs redundant allocation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting net degrees replaces explicit recursion or container structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check that slots never drops below zero before traversal completes and finishes at exactly zero.
